tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ yab zab rtsa gsum snying po'i skor las bla ma drag po pad+ma gtum po'i sgrub thabs dbang chog dang bcas pa dregs pa kun 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅/ /na mo gu ru pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍā ya/ ye shes rab khros gar dgu'i gzis/ /sa gsum dregs tshogs thal bar brlag /pad+ma gtum pos bdag byin rlob/ /smin byed zab mo'i lag len dgod/ khrag 'thung pad+ma gtum po'i smin byed bsgrub pa la sbyor ba stegs bu'i steng du maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu dmar po gcig dgod/ de steng khri'u'i khar bum pa so lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings dmar nag kha rgyan gseb tu sku tsag gis brgyan pa dang*/ mdun du dpal gtor/ g.yas su me long la bsnyen sngags mtshal gyis bris pa/ g.yon du rdo rje/ rgyab tu lcags kyu phur pa rnams bkod/ sman rag mchod pas bskor/ bsgral dbang byed na liṅga gdab phur zor gtor sogs kyang bsdogs/ gzhan yang nyer mkho rnams tshogs par byas la/ skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i mos pas/ na mo: mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir: bla ma dkon mchog rtsa gsum la: byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar: rtse gcig gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ ho: mar gyur rigs drug sems can la: byams dang snying rje chen po'i blos: byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i slad: zab mo'i lam la 'jug par bgyi: lan gsum/ tshogs bsags ni/ ho: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: gsang sngags bsgrub la rjes yi rangs: smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol bdebs: snying po sems can don du bsngo: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: lan gsum/ gnas yo byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gzung 'dzin chos kun rnam dag dbyings: ye shes rol pa'i zhing khams cher: phyi nang gsang ba rmad byung ba'i: mchod pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab gyur: badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ: oṃ badz+ra ar+gham̐ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da āḥhūm̐:

ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī ṭhā: lan gsum/ dngos gzhi bdag mdun chig rdzogs su sgrub pa ni/ hūm̐: stong gsal ngang las snod bcud kun: rab 'jigs drag po'i zhing khams dbus: pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi'i steng : rang rig chu las nya 'phar ltar: skad cig dran rdzogs thod phreng rtsal: gsang bdag pad+ma gtum po'i sku: mthing dmar lcags bsregs lta bu'i mdog: rab khraus gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: phyag g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu yis: sde brgyad 'byung po'i srog nas 'dren: g.yon pas sdig mdzub phur bu 'dril: ma rungs logs 'dren srog rtsa gcod: rtse las sprul pa'i lcags sdig 'phro: dam sri 'gong po hab hab za: spyi gtsug rta gdong rngams bzhad 'tsher: srid gsum g.yo zhing dbang du sdud: sku smad gnam lcags phur pa'i dbal: bar chad bdud bzhi'i snying la gzir: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu brjid: mkha' 'gro chos skyong las la gzud: gshog rtser khyung chen khra thabs lding : sa bdag klu srin thal bar rlog: ba spu'i khung bu thams cad kun: rab 'byams khro bo'i phyag rgyas gtams: gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan: thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od lcags kyu yis: ye shes 'khor bcas spyan drangs bsam/ spyan 'dren ni spos rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐: lho nub rak+sha'i pho brang nas: ma hā gu ru thod phreng rtsal: pad+ma gtum po'i skur bzhengs la: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ bzhugs gsol phyag mchod bstod pa sogs ni/ dam ye dbyer med brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pa'i dad phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang mchod sman gtor raka: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bzhes: sarba pū dza sa ma ya ho: pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal: dregs pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i tshul: pad+ma gtum po he ru kar: gus pas bstod do dngos grub stsol:

de nas bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la dbang bskur lta bu mdun dkyil sgrub skabs spro na 'dzab khang dbye/ thugs kar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐: sngags mtshan 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis: rtsa gsum mchod cing byin nus bsdus: 'gro drug sgrib sbyangs lha ru bsgyur: dregs pa sde brgyad zil gyis mnan: dam la mi gnas gdug pa kun: ye shes me yis gzhob bzhin bsregs: rjes shul lhag ma med par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm hā gu ru pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kī li kī la ya khroṃ ga ru ḍa ru bha sha sarba duṣ+tān hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bsnyen sgrub las sbyor chig dril gyi bzlas pa ci nus bya/ bum bzlas zur du spro na spyi ltar byas la mchod bstod dbang len nam rig me dor/ oṃ ha ya gṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis las bum gyi chu nus ldan du sgrub/ dbang dang ma 'brel na 'og gi bsdu ldang la 'jug pas chog cing*/ dbang bskur na slob ma rnams khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad cing srung 'khor gsal btab/ mtshams sbyor gyi khyad par/ de 'ang ji skad du/ byang chub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: srog bdag gza' klu rgyal 'gong btsan: bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa thams cad kyi: gnyen po gcig tu dril ba'i lha: pad+ma gtum po'i sgrub thabs 'di: o rgyan bla ma'i thugs khrag ste: ma 'ongs bod khams sdug bsngal dus: las 'phro can gyi dpal du shog: ces gsungs pa ltar/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi yang mtha' skye dgu'i rgyud ma rungs pa'i nyon mongs rang gzugs phyi rol du shar ba 'byung po gdug pa can gyi rnam par 'tshe bas lus can mtha' dag nad gdon glo bur gyi zug rngu 'phral dang yun tu sdug bsngal kho nas mnar ba la ched du dgongs te/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku slob dpon rdo rje thod phreng rtsal nyid gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyi gsang ba mtha' yas pa bstan pa rnams las snying po'i yang bcud che mchog drag po pad+ma gtum po'i gdams zab 'di nyid/

'ja' lus mkha' 'gro nyer lnga las shel dkar mgon skyid kyi sprul bsgyur mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa'i zab gter 'dus pa skor bzhi'i ldebs su byon cing*/ thams cad mkhyen gzigs bka' babs bdun ldan pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa la gu ru rin po che dang gter ston rnam dbyer med pa'i ye shes kyi skus smin grol nye brgyud du stsal/ bdag cag la smin byed kyis rjes su bzung ba'i tshe/ me long la bris pa'i sngags byang gi gzugs brnyan bsub tu med pa'i rang byon ngo mtshar can du shar bas mtshon/ byin rlabs gzi brjid lhag par 'bar ba ste/ gzhung las/ dbang 'di lan gcig thob pas kyang : pad+ma gtum pos byin brlabs nas: bar chad kun gyis nye mi nus: mthar thug dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub: ces bsngags pa don dang ldan pa'i smin byed zab mo bsgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang : pad+ma gtum po bdag la dgongs: khro rgyal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: byin rlabs dbang mchog stsal du gsol: lan gsum/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i khrag 'thung pad+ma gtum po la rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams sprin gtibs pa ltar bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyud dag pa'i phyir rgyun bshags yan lag brgyad pa tshul bzhin bya ba'i blos tshig don zung du 'brel ba'i bsgom don gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /sogs lan gsum/ de nas dbang gi gzhi 'god cing ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di ltar du sgoms/ hūm̐: stong gsal ngang las snod bcud kun: rab 'jigs drag po'i zhing khams dbus: pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi'i steng : rang rig chu las nya 'phar ltar: skad cig dran rdzogs thod phreng rtsal: gsang bdag pad+ma gtum po'i sku:

mthing dmar lcags bsregs lta bu'i mdog: rab khraus gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: phyag g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu yis: sde brgyad 'byung po'i srog nas 'dren: g.yon pas sdig mdzub phur bu 'dril: ma rungs logs 'dren srog rtsa gcod: rtse las sprul pa'i lcags sdig 'phro: dam sri 'gong po hab hab za: spyi gtsug rta gdong rngams bzhad 'tsher: srid gsum g.yo zhing dbang du sdud: sku smad gnam lcags phur pa'i dbal: bar chad bdud bzhi'i snying la gzir: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu brjid: mkha' 'gro chos skyong las la gzud: gshog rtser khyung chen khra thabs lding : sa bdag klu srin thal bar rlog: ba spu'i khung bu thams cad kun: rab 'byams khro bo'i phyag rgyas gtams: gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i skur gyur pa la ye shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs nas sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐: lho nub rak+sha'i pho brang nas: ma hā gu ru thod phreng rtsal: pad+ma gtum po'i skur bzhengs la: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm hā gu ru pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kī li kī la ya khroṃ ga ru ḍa ru bha sha sarba duṣ+tān hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra ā be sha ya a ā: btags pa brjod la ye shes pa dbab cing bstim/ rdo rje me tog mgor bzhag /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa brtan par bya/ dbang dngos la sku gsum thugs yon tan phrin las lnga yod pa las/ dang po sku'i dbang gi slad du/ rnam rgyal bum pa khrag 'thung pad+ma gtum po'i rten dang brten pa yongs su rdzogs pa khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag pas rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ ye shes kyi sku mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon/ dpral bar thim pas gzi brjid rab 'bar drag po'i sku dang dbyer med du gyur par mos shig /bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung pad+ma gtum po yi:

sku ni snang la rang bzhin bral: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed pa lha yi dbang thob shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gnyis pa gsung gi dbang gi slad du/ gtum po'i mgrin pa nas 'bar ba'i sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros/ mgrin par thim pas mthu nus stobs ldan drag po'i gsung dang dbyer med du gyur par mos shig /sngags byang mgrin par bzhag la/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung pad+ma gtum po yi: gsung ni ma 'gags rang byung dbyangs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bzlas pa sngags kyi dbang thob shog: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gsum pa thugs kyi dbang gi slad du: gtum po'i thugs ka nas ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba'i rnam pa byon: snying gar thim pas 'khrul rtog rtsad gcod drag po'i thugs dang dbyer med du gyur par mos shig /rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung pad+ma gtum po yi: thugs ni stong nyid rdo rje'i dbyings: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ting 'dzin dgongs pa'i dbang thob shog: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bzhi pa yon tan gyi dbang gi slad du: dpal gyi gtor ma khrag 'thung pad+ma gtum po dngos su gsal bas byin gyis brlabs pas gang 'dul re skong drag po'i yon tan dang dbyer med du gyur par mos shig /dpal gtor lte bar bzhag la/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung pad+ma gtum po yi: yon tan re skong yid bzhin gter: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul 'gro ba sgrol bar shog: gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lnga pa phrin las kyi dbang gi slad du: 'gugs sgrol gyi phyag 'tshan lag g.yas g.yon tu gtad pas thogs med rtsal ldan drag po'i phrin las dang dbyer med du gyur par mos shig /lcags kyu g.yas dang phur pa g.yon tu gtad la/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung pad+ma gtum po yi: phrin las dgra bgegs dgug cing sgrol: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mngon spyod stobs kyi dbang thob shog /karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas brub khung du liṅga bkod pa la dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ na moḥ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par che mchog pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis ma rungs pa'i sems can bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm hā gu ru pad+ma tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kī li kī la ya khroṃ ga ru ḍa ru bha sha sarba duṣ+tān hūm̐ phaṭa: dgra bgegs ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis bkug/ de nas khyed rang rnams la sngar byin pa'i las kyi phur bu de nyid 'dril bzhin du liṅga dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba la tshe lung khrus kyi dgongs pa dang ldan pas bsgral ba'i las mdzad par zhu/ hūṃ: pad+ma drag po'i gsod byed pho nya che: shin tu mi bzad yak+sha he ru ka: phyag g.yas rno dbal gdug pa'i phur bu 'dril: g.yon pas 'chor med lcags kyu rnon po gdengs: dgra bgegs gnod byed gdug cing gtum po'i tshogs: lcags kyus zung la phur bus snying gar thob: tshe bsod dwangs ma sgrub mchog rnams la stims: rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa'i sras su drongs: gzugs phung rdul phran bzhin du dum bur gtubs: mngon spyod stobs kyi phrin las yongs rdzogs mdzod: badz+ra yak+sha kī li kī la ya sarba duṣ+tān ā yur puṇ+ye dzaḥbh+rūm̐: nṛ tri bin+du a phaṭa: bhin+dha bhin+dha mā ra ya rbad: ces bsgral du bcug slar yang thun gyis brdeg bsad gris btubs la hom gzar du blug cing bstab pa ni/

hūm̐: pad+ma drag po'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs 'byung po bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: bde chen rdo rje'i longs spyod chen por bzhes: dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod: sarba shatrūn bigh+nān ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi: ling ro thun gtor du bstabs la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma gtum po che: dbyings nas brtser dgongs 'dir gshegs byin gyis rlobs: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor ma dang : sman raka phud kyi 'dod yon mchod par bzhes: rdo rje'i go chas 'gal rkyen bar chad srung : mi mthun zhi zhing mthun rkyen legs tshogs spel: khams gsum dbang sdus log lta cham la phog: rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub la 'tshe ba yi: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs srog rtsa dmar po chod: sde brgyad cho 'phrul 'byung bzhi'i g.yo 'khrugs dang : nad mtshon mu ge byad phur rbod gtong zlog: mngon spyod stobs kyi phrin las yongs rdzogs mdzod: aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs ma ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: thal brdab gtor ma dgra phyogs 'phang :

ces brjod la gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phen tu gzhug /me tog 'thor la/ oṃ/ rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang rtsa brgyud bla ma dang : sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur snang yi dam lha: rnal 'byor grogs mdzad gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yis: dngos grub dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: ces shis par brjod/ de ltar dbang thob nas dam tshig bsrung sdom gyi tha tshig bsgrag pa yin te/ de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyis: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la: bla ma gtsug gi rgyan du zungs: lha bsgom sngags bzlas rgyun ma bcad: rang gzhan don kun rtag tu sgrubs: ji ltar bsgos pa rnams tshul bzhin rjes su bsgrub pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos: gtso bos ji ltar sogs dbang gi rjes rim dang*/ gtang rag mchod bstod ni/ phyi nang gsang mchod sman gtor raka: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bzhes: sarba pū dza sa ma ya ho: pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal: dregs pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i tshul: pad+ma gtum po he ru kar: gus pas bstod do dngos grub stsol: yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ nyer bsdu ni/ a: 'gag med rig rtsal rol pa'i dkyil 'khor pa: rim gyis bdag thim 'od gsal ngang du bzhag: slar yang chu las rlabs kyi phreng ba ltar: dbyings rig rang shar phyag rgya'i lha skur shar: smon lam gdab pa ni/ ho: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs ci mchis pa: mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don du bsngos pa'i mthus: bdag gzhan mi gnas ye shes myur thob shog: shis brjod ni/ shin tu zhi ba chos sku'i dbyings nyid las: rig pa rang shar bde chen longs spyod rdzogs: gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad sprul pa'i skur: dbyer med mngon par byang chub bkra shis shog: ces sogs bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /'dis kyang zab cing dkon pa'i chos/

/gdul bya mu mtha' yas par 'phel/ /kun kyang pad+ma gtum po dang*/ /dbyer med che btsan zla bral shog /ces 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyis spel ba'i dbang chog la las byang dkyus su gsar bsgrig bcas phun tshogs rnam rgyal pas bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// //
